data.summary: All figures match NVIDIA's FY2022 and FY2021 results as I recall them: revenue $26.9B vs $16.7B (+61.4%), gross profit $17.5B vs $10.4B (64.9% margin), operating income $10.0B vs $4.5B (37.3% margin), net income $9.8B vs $4.3B (+125.1%), split-adjusted diluted EPS $3.85 vs $1.73, R&D $5.3B vs $3.9B.
